name: Sarutobi: Latent Advanced Chakra Control I

system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 2

Beginning at 3rd level, Select between the following; Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can use Jutsu with the select Keyword with a level of efficiency others wish they had. You may reduce the cost of the select combination of keywords by 1. / If Ninjutsu, select between the following keywords that you have access to; (Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Lightning) Release. / If Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, select between the following keywords; Combo or Finisher. / If Genjutsu, select between the following Keywords; Auditory, Inhaled, Tactile, and Visual.
